review_note: Read the test and helper line by line. Hashes (receipt, manifest, test, all manifest files) match. The Mac console log shows 66 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, with all 3 'b31jb phylo_interaction' lines present. Totoro native run only skips (live test), so counts rest on the Mac log. Oracle: base-R dense Laplace. The pair covariance is hand-built as K1[host] x K2[pollinator] from cov2cor(ape::vcv) of two random trees (48 pairs, 25 observations each), and both package tip covariances are checked against the hand kernels at 1e-10. Agreement is 2e-6 to 3e-6 at the Julia estimates. Bug sensitivity: selector swap, SD sign, reversed SD, SD intercept shift, K x 2, raw vcv, each tree ignored in turn, and kernel by position all move the oracle. The smallest gap is 0.193 (logit, kernel by position) against 1e-3, about x193, and other gaps are 0.6 to 164. The optimum check passes. Row: phylo_interaction_intercept (pair-level structured intercept, single phylogenetic interaction field) is fitted by phylo_interaction(1 | host:pollinator, tree1, tree2) with sd(pair, level='phylogenetic_interaction') ~ z, so all 3 linked rows (logit, probit, cloglog) are exercised by the named route. Does NOT establish: calibration or coverage, other trees, sizes or seeds (one fixture), interaction with extra fields or slopes, a pair-level correlation, or native-engine behaviour.
